summary: Reproduced both independent-review counterexamples at candidate commit 6f9ba912ed5a5a9ff2434f7505e86326bff8c20d, preserved its Qwen3-VL fixes, added MOSS-VL concatenating-merger LoRA dimensions, and bounded indexed-layer parsing to path segments.

tests.what_was_measured: At the unmodified candidate, both MOSS linear_fc dimension requests failed and the notdeepstack_merger_list namespace returned layer 4. Raw output: reports/j-b78e5d0f5402/raw/candidate_counterexamples.log
23 tests passed for Qwen3-VL and MOSS-VL dimensions, normalization, sharding metadata, valid/malformed indices, namespace boundaries, and existing model-specific fallback behavior.
All applicable repository formatting, lint, safety, and CI-registration hooks passed.
BF16 rank-32 Qwen projection arithmetic at 4608x4608 and 4608x4096 ran on AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 and was compared with CPU FP32 references.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-b78e5d0f5402/raw/gpu_linear_fc_reference.log records execution on AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. This is projection arithmetic evidence only.

remaining_limitations: Qwen3-VL-8B/EditScore and MOSS-VL model/adapter weights were unavailable, so full model loading and HTTP serving were not verified.
The available GPU was ROCm gfx950 rather than the report's H100/CUDA platform.
The GPU fixture validates Qwen projection shapes and arithmetic only; it does not qualify MOSS-VL architecture execution or semantic multimodal output.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
